intro: Delhi rewards visitors with layers of history, vibrant markets and rich food. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: Delhi Metro is cheap, air-conditioned and fast; fares ₹10-60, more on the Airport Express.
Metro runs 9 lines; Yellow and Orange lines serve New Delhi station.
DTC and Blue-Line buses are frequent and very cheap, ₹5-25, but crowded.
Ride apps Uber and Ola work well; use prepaid taxi booths at stations and the airport.
Driving is chaotic; hiring a car with driver is common for day trips.
Central New Delhi is fairly walkable with footbridges and subways; no ferries.

appu_ghar.name: Appu Ghar (Gurgaon)
appu_ghar.price_text: Ticket prices vary by ride pass — check on the day
appu_ghar.hours: Check on the day; usually open late morning to evening
appu_ghar.tip: This is a water-and-rides park outside the city, so plan a half day and bring a change of clothes.

butter_chicken.name: Butter Chicken
butter_chicken.price_text: ≈ INR 400–700 per plate at a mid-range restaurant
butter_chicken.tip: The dish was invented in Delhi, so try it at an old-school restaurant rather than a hotel buffet.

kingdom_of_dreams.name: Kingdom of Dreams
kingdom_of_dreams.price_text: Show tickets vary — check on the day
kingdom_of_dreams.hours: Show times vary; check before you go
kingdom_of_dreams.tip: This live-entertainment complex in Gurgaon has had long closures, so confirm it is open before travelling.

worlds_of_wonder.name: Worlds of Wonder Amusement Park
worlds_of_wonder.price_text: Ride passes vary — check on the day
worlds_of_wonder.hours: Usually around 11:00–19:00; confirm on the day
worlds_of_wonder.tip: It is far out in Noida, so allow extra travel time and go early on a weekday.

chandni_chowk.name: Chandni Chowk market walk
chandni_chowk.price_text: Free to walk; food and rickshaws extra
chandni_chowk.hours: Shops roughly 10:00–20:00, closed Sunday in parts
chandni_chowk.tip: Go early morning for calm lanes and fresh parathas; hold your bag close in crowds.

paranthe_wali_gali.name: Paranthe Wali Gali
paranthe_wali_gali.tip: Order a stuffed paratha and share a few; the lane is narrow and busy at lunch.

jama_masjid.name: Jama Masjid
jama_masjid.price_text: Small camera fee; entry usually free — check on the day
jama_masjid.tip: Dress modestly and remove shoes; climb the minaret for a view over Old Delhi.

red_fort.name: Red Fort (Lal Qila)
red_fort.price_text: Entry fee applies for foreign visitors — check on the day
red_fort.tip: Buy tickets online to skip the queue and go early before the heat.

humayuns_tomb.name: Humayun's Tomb
humayuns_tomb.price_text: Entry fee applies for foreign visitors — check on the day
humayuns_tomb.tip: Come at opening time for soft light and few people; the gardens are a good place to slow down.

india_gate.name: India Gate and Kartavya Path
india_gate.tip: Walk the wide avenue in the evening when locals gather for ice cream and the monument is lit.

lodhi_garden.name: Lodhi Garden
lodhi_garden.tip: A quiet green break with old tombs; go early for joggers and birdsong.

cp_walk.name: Connaught Place walk
cp_walk.price_text: Free to walk; cafes and shops extra
cp_walk.tip: The white colonnades are easy to navigate; stop for coffee and people-watch in the inner circle.

karol_bagh_market.name: Karol Bagh market
karol_bagh_market.tip: Good for street snacks and cheap clothes; bargain politely and keep valuables zipped.

paharganj_walk.name: Paharganj backpacker lanes
paharganj_walk.hours: Busy from late morning to late night
paharganj_walk.tip: Right by New Delhi station; it is lively and cheap but crowded, so watch your belongings.

aerocity_dining.name: Aerocity dining and cafes
aerocity_dining.tip: Handy for a meal near the airport; it is a modern complex, not old Delhi, so set expectations.

old_delhi_food_tour.name: Old Delhi street food tour
old_delhi_food_tour.price_text: ≈ INR 1500–3000 per person — check on the day
old_delhi_food_tour.hours: Tours usually run morning and evening
old_delhi_food_tour.tip: A guided walk helps you find safe, well-known stalls; eat freshly cooked hot food and drink bottled water.

cycle_rickshaw.name: Cycle-rickshaw ride in Old Delhi
cycle_rickshaw.price_text: ≈ INR 100–300 per ride — agree the price first
cycle_rickshaw.tip: Fix the fare before you start and expect tight, bumpy lanes.

spice_market.name: Khari Baoli spice market
spice_market.price_text: Free to browse; spices sold by weight
spice_market.tip: The air is strong with chilli; cover your nose on upper floors and buy small amounts.

raj_ghat.name: Raj Ghat
raj_ghat.tip: A calm memorial garden; remove shoes before the platform and keep quiet.

delhi_metro.name: Delhi Metro day travel
delhi_metro.price_text: Fares ≈ INR 10–60 per trip; day card available
delhi_metro.tip: Fast and cheap way to cross the city; avoid rush hours and keep bags in front of you.

gurgaon_cyberhub.name: Cyber Hub, Gurgaon
gurgaon_cyberhub.tip: A modern dining complex for an easy evening; it is a long metro ride from central Delhi.

airport_transfer.name: Airport transfer planning
airport_transfer.price_text: Airport Metro ≈ INR 60; taxi ≈ INR 500–900 — check on the day
airport_transfer.tip: Allow plenty of time for traffic; the Airport Express line is the most predictable option.

stays.why: Cheapest beds, walk to New Delhi station and the Metro, and a short ride to Old Delhi. Busy and noisy streets.
Central, walkable and on the Yellow and Blue lines. Good for first-timers who want shops and cafés nearby.
Next to the airport with the Orange line link. Best for short layovers or early flights, far from the sights.
Mid-range hotels, a big shopping street and its own Metro stop. Lively and good value.

food: Start with street chaat: golgappa, papdi chaat and aloo tikki. Pick busy stalls and eat freshly made food.
Old Delhi is the kebab and paratha heartland. Try a paratha lane breakfast and seek out a famous kebab shop.
Order butter chicken or dal makhani at a classic North Indian restaurant. Book ahead on weekends.
Vegetarian thalis are cheap and filling, often ₹150–400. Many places are pure veg.
Drink only bottled or filtered water, and skip ice and cut fruit from street carts if your stomach is sensitive.
more_time: Day trip to Agra for the Taj Mahal: early train or a hired car with driver, roughly 3–4 hours each way. Check timings on the day.
Swap a city day for Humayun's Tomb, Qutub Minar and Lotus Temple in south Delhi, all on the Metro.
Add a half-day to Chandni Chowk spice market and the Red Fort, then rest in a haveli café.
